title: Dr. Ahmad Ali Represents AWKUM at International Digital Education Conference in Malaysia
text:
```html

Dr. Ahmad Ali, Associate Professor, Department of Sociology,
Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan (AWKUM), represented AWKUM at
the 2nd International Digital Education Conference (IDEC) in Malaysia,
where he delivered a keynote address and was nominated as an
Inbound Visiting Scholar at INTI International University.

Held in collaboration with
INTI International University
,
the hybrid conference brought together researchers and academics from

Germany, Iran, India, Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, Oman, China,
and other countries
for research presentations, knowledge
exchange, and academic networking.

Dr. Ahmad Ali expressed his

sincere gratitude to the worthy Vice Chancellor and Dean,
Faculty of Social Sciences, AWKUM, for their trust and confidence
in assigning him to represent the university

,

and to

GISSR for its financial support and facilitation

of his participation.

The conference provided valuable opportunities for international
academic exchange, research collaboration, and strengthening
scholarly connections.

❮

❯

Dr. Ahmad Ali representing Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan
at the International Digital Education Conference in Malaysia.

The participation reflects AWKUM's commitment to international
academic engagement, research collaboration, digital education,
and scholarly networking.

```
